dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped pixel clusters on the anterior half; dark perimeters show high contrast against lighter interior regions with undulating, non-linear edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of small, dark, circular pixel groups along the lower lateral quadrant of the mid-body, exhibiting high core intensity and minimal internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular spatial arrangement formed by the centroids of the three most prominent annuli located in the upper-left dorsal-lateral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, vertically aligned, dark circular areas of high shadow depth on the lower-mid flank, consistent with localized surface depressions.
other_distinctive_markers: A clear spatial gradient transition from high-contrast macro-patterns on the anterior portion to a more homogenous, low-contrast, fine-grained speckled texture on the posterior third of the body.
